Stage draws Poterx’s own soft colors. Picture shows a picture of yours behind every screen. Plain is a flat dark fill.
The Poterx logo in the menu, About and setup shows its play triangle in your accent color. The icon on the home screen keeps its own colors.

Dark is what Poterx is designed for. System follows the TV’s own setting where it has one; Light suits a bright room.
Looks for a new version each time Poterx starts and tells you when there is one. Nothing is installed without asking.

If a live channel has shown no picture by this time, Poterx stops trying and tells you, instead of leaving a black screen while it works through every player it has. Never keeps trying, which can take well over a minute on a channel your provider has removed. Waits your provider asks for are not counted.
Send all Poterx traffic and playback through an HTTP proxy.
This device does not allow Poterx to set exact alarms, so a recording may begin a few minutes late. Recordings start earlier to make up for it.

On any device with a browser on the same Wi-Fi — a phone, a computer or another TV — scan the QR (or open the URL), enter this PIN, choose your Poterx backup file and send it. You then pick what to restore here.
Poterx could not work out how many channels this provider allows.

Many providers never say how many channels you may watch at the same time, so Poterx finds out by opening a few and seeing which ones survive. Anything playing now will stop, and this can take up to two minutes.
Surround — send Dolby/DTS to a real 5.1/7.1 receiver. If it goes silent or stutters, Poterx still falls back to stereo and tells you.

Poterx is a media player only. It includes no channels, playlists, or content. You are responsible for adding your own legally accessible Xtream, M3U, or Stalker sources.

Your TMDB API key and self-hosted server address will be deleted from this device, and the app will go back to the built-in shared service with its daily share.

The built-in metadata service is shared by every installation. If any minute, hourly or daily allowance is used up, TMDB details pause until that window resets; playlist information keeps working. Your own key or Worker removes this allowance.
